title: Reranking-based Generation for Unbiased Perspective Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unbiased political representation in summaries by measuring 'Perspective Coverage' (the ratio of the target political perspective's key points included) and 'Perspective Faithfulness' (the exclusion of content unsupported by the target perspective or from the opposing side) using human annotations and LLM-as-a-judge metrics on a dataset of left- and right-leaning articles.

Assessing the model's tendency to favor input text based on its location in the prompt context by comparing baseline generation against mechanistic attention-modification methods (e.g., PINE) to determine if mitigating positional bias improves balanced perspective coverage.
